capabilities: Move the pinned tab to the new day's daily note without stealing focus
Pin the first tab showing today's note when no daily tab is pinned
Unpin any extra pinned daily tabs so only one remains
Open today's daily note via command, reusing or creating the pinned tab
Create missing daily notes and folders from the configured template
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and installation is manual (copy main.js and manifest.json into the plugins folder).
intentEvidence: This plugin sits on top of your daily notes plugin, which stays the source of truth
problem: A manually pinned daily note tab stays pinned to yesterday after the date rolls over, so the pin stops being useful.

relations.evidence: This plugin sits on top of your daily notes plugin, which stays the source of truth
Auto-detect (default): Periodic Notes (if its daily notes are enabled), then Notebook Navigator
Notebook Navigator's settings are read from periodicNotesFolder and calendarCustomFilePattern

requires.name: a daily note source (core Daily notes, Periodic Notes, or Notebook Navigator)

summary: Tab-pinning helper that keeps one pinned tab on today's daily note and moves that pin to the new note when the day changes.
